We present MesaTask, a novel LLM-based framework for generating task-oriented 3D tabletop scenes directly from high-level human instructions, featuring realistic layouts, articulated objects, and complex inter-object relations like stacking and containment. Figure 2. The dataset construction pipeline. First, an LLM is used to generate diverse tabletop scene descriptions, including relevant object lists and spatial relations. Conditioned on the scene description, a text-to-image model synthesizes reference images, from which coarse 3D layouts are built using depth estimation, object detection, and 3D asset retrieval.
